chunks: Then how can you disbelieve in God? He gave you life when you were dead. He will make you die again then bring you back to life: To Him then you will return.

key_terms.يُحْيِيكُمْ: He will bring you back to life

ai.seo_question: What is the logical argument for resurrection in Surah Al-Baqarah verse 28?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the physical resurrection (Ba'th al-Jasad) and the cyclical nature of human existence, emphasizing that just as God brought life from non-existence, He will restore the body for judgment. It serves as a logical proof for the afterlife, countering materialist views by highlighting the Creator's absolute power over the stages of life, death, and return.
